create_FrameData: create a FrameData object to store image batches, depth batches, and camera pose transformations
add_frame_data_FrameData: add new FrameData to an existing FrameData object by concatenating or replacing batch attributes
expand_data: expand a batch by concatenating new data or replacing the last row in the batch
compute_scene_properties: compute the oriented bounding box, extents, and center of a 3D mesh scene from a file path
save_trajectory: save a camera trajectory to a file in replica, realsense_franka, or TUM format with timestamps
